pages.description: STS-73 marked second flight of U.S. Microgravity Laboratory (USML) and built on foundation of its predecessor, which flew on Columbia during Mission STS-50 in 1992. Research during USML-2 concentrated within same overall areas of USML-1, with many experiments flying for second time. Crew divided into two teams to work around the clock in 23-foot (seven-meter) long Spacelab module located in Columbia's payload bay.

pages.text: Stunning Scottish pterosaur is biggest fossil of its kind | National Geographic SCIENCE Stunning Scottish pterosaur is biggest fossil of its kind The well-preserved find from Scotland’s Isle of Skye offers a rare peek into the evolutionary journey of these ancient wonders on wings. A new genus of pterosaur found on the wave-battered coastline of Scotland's Isle of Skye may have had a wingspan of more than 8.2 feet (2.5 meters), in line with today's biggest albatrosses. By the looks of its bone structure, the winged reptile wasn't done growing when it died. Illustration by Natalia Jagielska By Michael Greshko Published February 22, 2022 • 10 min read Some 167 million years ago over what is now Scotland’s Isle of Skye, a winged reptile, possibly as big as an albatross, soared over a subtropical lagoon, nabbing fish and squid in its toothy maw as dinosaurs thundered across the shorelines. Somehow this reptile perished, and its carcass was quickly entombed in sediments on the bottom of that lagoon. In 2017 a chance discovery along Skye’s wave-battered coastlines revealed the resulting fossil: the best of its kind found in two centuries. Unveiled today in the journal Current Biology , the fossil—called Dearc sgiathanach (pronounced “jark ski-an-ach”)—is spectacularly well preserved, with portions of the skull, limb bones, tail, ribs, and vertebrae still intact. pages.text: Subminimum Wage | U.S. Department of Labor Skip to main content Subminimum Wage More in This Section Close Industrial Homeworker Instructions for Form WH-205: Application to Employ Student-Learners at Subminimum Wages Overview Subminimum Wage Provisions The Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) provides for the employment of certain individuals at wage rates below the statutory minimum. Such individuals include student-learners (vocational education students), as well as full-time students employed in retail or service establishments, agriculture, or institutions of higher education. Also included are individuals whose earning or productive capacities are impaired by a physical or mental disability, including those related to age or injury, for the work to be performed. Search Twitter YouTube Facebook Instagram Flickr LinkedIn Swainson’s Hawks: a remarkable return to California’s Central Valley Oct 19, 2026 Swainson’s Hawks are medium-to-large raptors renowned for their elegant flight and extraordinary migratory journeys. Each year, these hawks travel thousands of miles between their breeding grounds in the western United States and Canada and their wintering sites in Central and South America. California’s Central Valley is especially critical to their life cycle, with 95 percent of the state’s Swainson’s Hawks nesting there. Upon arrival in the Central Valley, Swainson’s Hawks select nest sites near grasslands or agricultural fields, which offer abundant prey and shelter. During the breeding season, their diet consists mainly of rodents, rabbits, reptiles, and small birds, which are essential for raising their young. Outside the breeding season, they adapt by feeding primarily on insects such as grasshoppers, demonstrating remarkable versatility.
